preconditions.description: The number of nodes in the tree is between 1 and 10^6, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: The tree is rooted at node 1

postconditions.expression: The output is an integer representing the maximum number of connected components that can be obtained after applying the operation any number of times.
postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum number of connected components that can be achieved by strategically assassinating corrupt officials and their ancestors.
